how: We read the website of every Indianapolis wedding DJ listed on Lazo (36 listings, 29 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a national DJ chain with an Indianapolis landing page, a ballroom dance studio, a casino-and-games party company, a national franchise page, and DJs whose site said almost nothing. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Who exactly will DJ my wedding, and can I meet that person before signing?
How do you handle ceremony audio and the toasts, and do you bring a separate system for an outdoor barn ceremony?
What is in the base price, and what are uplighting, a photo booth and extra hours on top if the reception runs late?

picks.name: Q It Up Sounds & Entertainment
picks.blurb: Billy Quesenberry runs Q It Up out of Fishers with over 15 years of DJ experience, serving all of Indiana but mainly Indianapolis. He pitches himself as help with planning the wedding day, not just the music, and packages are built around up to five hours of entertainment starting at cocktail hour.

picks.name: First Class Sound & Light of Indianapolis
picks.blurb: Behind the decks since age 14, the owner of First Class Sound & Light pitches lighting and music together as what builds a wedding's atmosphere. The site prints DJ and enhancement pricing for Indianapolis weddings, and every package includes two-plus hours of early setup not counted against booked time.

picks.name: VIP Event DJ featuring Dave Howard and Jason Turner
picks.blurb: Dave Howard has entertained in a variety of roles for 19 years, and VIP Event DJ guarantees to pack your dance floor or your money back. Expect a high-energy show built to get every guest onto the floor at the same time to kick off the dancing, from Fishers.

picks.name: Mac Events
picks.blurb: Ryan 'MAC' McDonald found DJing in 2001, and MAC Events now claims a combined 50-plus years of events experience across its team. Music, MCing and production from ceremony to last call, for weddings across Indiana, Ohio and Illinois, out of Greenwood.

picks.name: Grapevine DJs & Photo Booth
picks.blurb: Mark Beecher has DJ'd Indianapolis weddings for more than 20 years with a stated style of no cheesy routines and no unnecessary microphone chatter, just planning, smooth transitions and letting the music talk. Ceremony sound and a photo booth are available, and the site shows real weddings by venue.

picks.name: Keller Entertainment Group
picks.blurb: Josh at Keller Entertainment Group describes a personalized, high-class DJ experience from ceremony audio through cocktail hour to the dance floor, with weddings that feel intentional and tailored to the couple. He also works school dances and corporate events across Central Indiana.

picks.name: Platinum DJ Productions
picks.blurb: A team of six named DJs, David Boyce, Mark Smith, Dave Guarino, David Hairston, Chris Sims and Anthony Champion, with wedding packages, add-on packages and live entertainment. Platinum DJ Productions in Greenwood offers an online bridal suite tool for planning the music.

picks.name: Jim Cerone The Perfect Host DJ MC
picks.blurb: Jim Cerone gives Perfect Host seminars to the event and DJ industries across the US, UK and Australia, works as an on-camera host and voice talent through the Helen Wells Agency, and is a past president of the Indiana chapter of ILEA. Fishers-based, pitching a fast-moving party and a full floor.

picks.name: Event One DJs
picks.blurb: For more than 28 years Event One has hosted weddings throughout Central and Southern Indiana, and founder Wes Adkins has hosted over 500 of them himself. The pitch is crowd-reading and a packed dance floor, backed by couples' quotes on the site.

picks.name: T-Bone Disc Jockey
picks.blurb: Owner Troy Hanna brings over 25 years of DJ experience, and the T-Bone team promises smooth coordination, clear announcements and a packed floor, working closely with your other vendors to catch every key moment. Based in Pittsboro, west of the city.

picks.name: Sound Advice DJ's and Live Entertainment
picks.blurb: Mike Campbell started Sound Advice in 1990 with one philosophy: combine a love of music with the highest quality of service in the industry. DJs and live entertainment from Greenwood, with Mike involved from the first meeting to the day itself.

picks.name: Digital Monkey Music
picks.blurb: Entertaining since 1986, starting with school dances while still in school and a radio career at 17; the owner is a Christian and a Knights of Columbus member, a former SCUBA instructor and an FAA-certified A&P technician. Digital Monkey Music is a full-service wedding DJ company in Shelbyville that helps plan the day.
